description: This file defines functions and hooks for input resharding in distributed tensor parallelism within PyTorch, including registration of hooks to shard and restore tensor inputs during backward passes.

methods.name: input_reshard
methods.description: Registers hooks to an nn.Module for input resharding to enable sharding and restoration during backward computation.

methods.name: _pack_hook_tp
methods.description: Hook function called after forward pass to shard input tensor.

methods.name: _unpack_hook_tp
methods.description: Hook function called before backward pass to restore input tensor from sharded form.
